caveats: New-process startup may use warm OS and project parse artifacts. No burst-typing percentile claim.
Diagnostic timing ends at the matching edited-document-version notification, not whole-workspace diagnostic completion.
Physical footprint lifetime peak is not peak RSS. Boundary samples do not establish a memory ceiling.

Owner phase timings are nested one-process mechanism observations, separate from the three-process timing series. Instrumented counters were collected concurrently with correctness/build jobs and do not qualify elapsed latency.

Background edits use a small separate mutable consumer while freezing the real DUT. Original-file scenarios use configured stable siblings/packages; SoC original-file package reuse does not freeze its edited RTL.

Baseline b7004f9 and current use the same repaired UVM fixtures. Warning representatives now use stable semantic ordering; error and package behavior remain unchanged. Raw public digests include fixture URIs, so correctness comparisons use a same-fixture Native oracle.
Direct retention is restricted to independently isolated initial top-level forests; compact type closure and Native fallback remain.
